title: That All You Got — EN/ES/JA (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar Spanish Japanese language learning warm baritone 108bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual rugby true story Australian character portrait
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Two men put their weight on his back.
He rolled. The way a trained man rolls.
Stood up. Turned around.
"That all you got, boys?"

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
Dos hombres pusieron su peso en su espalda. (Two men put their weight on his back.)
Él giró. Como un hombre entrenado gira. (He rolled. The way a trained man rolls.)
Se levantó. Se dio la vuelta. (Stood up. Turned around.)
"¿Eso es todo lo que tienen, chicos?" (That all you got, boys?)
Primera división — es específico. (First grade — that is specific.)
No es recreativo. (Not recreational.)
Es un tipo diferente de serio. (A different kind of serious.)
El rebote de eso (The bounce of that)
Se mostró una noche en un estacionamiento. (Showed up one night in a car park.)

[Chorus - Japanese, with English translations]
それが全てですか (That all you got)
簡単に言いました (He said it easy)
それが全てですか (That all you got)
立ち直った位置から振り返った (Turned from a recovered position)
それが全てですか (That all you got)
一年生ラグビーが実世界で (First grade rugby at real-world scale)
それが全てですか (That all you got)
ジョエル・アーロン・マクアイバー (Joel Aaron McIvor)
それが全てです (That all you got)

[Bridge - all three]
English: First grade. You don't get there by accident.
Spanish: Primera división. No llegas ahí por accidente. (First grade. You don't get there by accident.)
Japanese: ファーストグレード。偶然そこに到達することはありません。(First grade. You don't get there by accident.)

[Outro - all three]
English: That all you got — standing clean — that all you got
Spanish: ¿Eso es todo? — de pie limpio — ¿eso es todo? (That all you got — standing clean — that all you got)
Japanese: それが全て — まっすぐ立って — それが全て (That all — standing straight — that all)
